Cancellation policy
1. Free cancellation window
You can cancel a booking free of charge up to 12 hours before its start time. Any credits or cash paid are returned per our refund rules.
2. Late cancellation
Cancelling within 12 hours of the start time is not eligible for a refund or credit reversal — the full amount paid is forfeited.
3. No-shows
A booking that is neither cancelled nor attended is treated as used in full. No refund or credit reversal applies.
4. Changing your date or time
You may move a booking to a different date or time, free of charge, up to 12 hours before the original start time, subject to availability.
5. Event Space deposit
The refundable deposit is returned in full after your event, provided there is no damage and no additional cleaning is required.
6. Early termination of a recurring booking
Placeholder text — contact the BizPlus team at least 7 days in advance to end a recurring booking arrangement early.
